method: Every page viewed individually. After the final appendix-only scope clarification, page16 was re-rendered and re-inspected; pages1--15 had byte-identical PNGs to the inspected version.

pages.notes: Title, abstract and introduction are legible; empty author block preserves the venue layout.
Architecture arrows and caption fit; body and TV display stay inside columns.
Finite-message equations and section transitions fit without overlap.
Criterion, endpoint identity and verified-band display are fully readable.
Markov matrix, explicit bound and fixed-endpoint tradeoff fit the columns.
Guarded-code theorem, proof and implementation prose are readable.
Exact-audit table and transition to simulation are readable; standard class spacing retained.
Two-panel scientific plot, axis labels, legends and caption are clear.
Upstream comparison table has complete headers, intervals and denominators.
Four-panel upstream control figure and outcome table are legible, with no clipping.
Controlled-model table and endpoint-replay discussion fit the columns.
Delivery and endpoint tables and related-work transition are clear.
Main text ends before references; URLs and bibliography entries fit.
Open-science, ethics, AI-use statements and Markov proof opening are readable.
Safe-interval and killed-kernel equations, cases and proof text fit.
Final scope clarification, reverse-error formula and finite-grid proof are readable.
